The44documented waste-composition/heating-value coordinates agree, including2%wet-model water despite reserved0%labels; composition agreement does not establish landfill or LCIA equivalence. Source sanitary landfill is20m high,30year operation, with collected/treated leachate for100years and carbonate-phase estimate5693years; native mineral-construction landfill is11m high,15year operation,60,000year extrapolation and carbonate phase beyond60,000years. Landfill design, leachate collection/treatment, climate/hydrology, release timing, short/long-term speciation, land use, infrastructure, auxiliary materials/energy, allocation, internal uncertainty, geography and vintage differ; the full native service replaces the source internal inventory, including21direct elementary and49technosphere terms.
